items.reason: Seizing nine Vietnamese boats in the EEZ off West Kalimantan/Natuna continues the 2009 seizures of Vietnamese boats shown by prev-run candidate ev-da4d8bf65e; provisional until 2009 is decided.

Navy warships already patrolled and made seizures off Ranai in 2009 (prev-run candidate ev-868363285a, KRI Imam Bonjol); a two-week 'combat-alert' patrol by four fast patrol boats is the same anti-poaching presence, unless the coder finds it larger than 2009's patrols.

Arresting a Chinese boat near Natuna repeats the 2009 seizure of Chinese trawlers (prev-run candidate ev-76df87e6ee); Indonesia's own act did not change, and this time the boat was released under Yuzheng 311's guns. Provisional.

The UN note verbale denying the nine-dotted line any legal basis is Indonesia's first formal written legal challenge to China's line. The 2009 record shows only rejections of China's protest over one seizure (prev-run candidates ev-8356b4f7df, ev-2d42351825), not a challenge to the claim itself.

Seizing a Malaysian boat in Natuna waters resumes enforcement against Malaysian vessels, which is absent from the 2009 record (prev-run candidates show Vietnamese, Taiwanese and Chinese seizures only) and last seen in 2008. Chosen as lead because it is clearly inside the area.

Seizing five Malaysian boats off Tanjung Berakit (Bintan) is the same 2010 resumption of enforcement against Malaysian vessels as ev-ab81cc727a. Only if the coder accepts that location as the southern South China Sea; otherwise reject it as outside the area.

The protest note to Malaysia over the arrest of Indonesian officers follows directly from the Bintan seizure (ev-a7a3a38eaa), so it belongs to the 2010 assertion of jurisdiction against Malaysia led by ev-ab81cc727a. A coder may prefer to make it a separate declarative move, with nothing comparable in 2009.
A warship's seizure of two Vietnamese boats near Natuna continues the 2009 practice shown by prev-run candidate ev-da4d8bf65e; provisional.

Operasi Jaring took 20+ Vietnamese boats in two weeks, more than any single 2009 seizure (ev-da4d8bf65e), but there is no 2009 annual figure to compare, and the rise tracks more Vietnamese boats rather than a new method (Chubb's counterfactual). Kept as a continuation; a coder with 2009 totals may see a frequency move.
A frigate's seizure of Vietnamese-crewed boats in the Natuna EEZ continues the 2009 practice of ev-da4d8bf65e; provisional.
Seizing Vietnamese-crewed pair trawlers in the Indonesian EEZ continues the 2010 practice of ev-fb5b1ef1f4 at the same level; provisional.
A corvette's seizure of a Vietnamese boat taken to Ranai continues the 2010 naval seizures of ev-f0c68a475a; provisional.
The Hiu patrol vessels' seizure of five Vietnamese trawlers in the Natuna EEZ continues the 2010 practice of ev-fb5b1ef1f4; provisional.
Six Vietnamese trawlers seized at about 05°55'N 108°03'E fall within the area of the 2010 seizures (ev-fb5b1ef1f4, ev-f0c68a475a near 5°N), so there is no change of method or area; provisional.
A warship's seizure of a Vietnamese boat north-east of Pulau Laut continues the 2010 naval seizures of ev-f0c68a475a; provisional.

Seizures of Vietnamese and Malaysian boats continue the 2010 practice: ev-fb5b1ef1f4 (about 40 boats seized nationwide by April 2010), and ev-ab81cc727a for the Malaysian boats. The 2011 tally of 73 boats by August has no full-year 2010 figure to compare. Provisional.
A five-day police operation seizing ten Vietnamese boats in Natuna waters repeats the 2010 police Operasi Jaring (ev-8b71ba1ad7) at a lower level; provisional.
Seizing three Vietnamese trawlers in the Natuna EEZ continues the 2011 Hiu-vessel seizures of ev-86a4b2bec4; provisional.
Seizing a Vietnamese boat off Bintan on a routine EEZ patrol continues the 2011 practice of ev-4a18c7fc41; provisional.
The 'again' seizure of nine Vietnamese boats in the Natuna EEZ continues the 2011 practice of ev-86a4b2bec4 (and ev-a2b3df6ddf, six boats); no change of method. Provisional.

The Foreign Minister's public refusal to recognise China's claim map in its new passports has nothing comparable in the 2011 record, which holds only fisheries seizures; the 2010 note verbale (ev-8f0fcd63d9) was absent in 2011, so a verbal challenge to China's line is new again.

Seizing Malaysian boats in the Natuna EEZ was seen in 2010 (ev-ab81cc727a) and 2011 (ev-e0e95d419d, 7 Malaysian), but no 2012 candidate shows it, so it is new again only if 2012 truly had none. Settled by KKP's 2012 seizure tally by flag; if Malaysian boats were taken in 2012 it is a continuation.

Arresting a Chinese trawler 200 km north-east of Natuna resumes enforcement against Chinese boats, absent from the 2011 and 2012 records and last seen in 2010 (ev-5c94654b46), so it is new again. The evidence is a captain's report published later; Indonesia made no statement.
Seizing two Vietnamese trawlers in Natuna waters continues the 2012 practice of ev-d2d02adea6; provisional.
Hiu Macan 01's seizure of three Vietnamese boats in Natuna waters repeats its 2012 seizures (ev-d2d02adea6, ev-f37f9b3333); provisional.
Seizing two Vietnamese trawlers in Natuna waters continues the 2012 practice of ev-d2d02adea6. The ministry's seven Vietnamese boats in two months gives no step up against 2012. Provisional.

Staging the culminating phase of the Air Force's Angkasa Yudha exercise at Natuna, with 21 combat aircraft, has nothing comparable in the 2012 record; the 2008 Natuna joint exercise (ev-7887a06047, other run) is long past. Less certain if the coder treats Angkasa Yudha as an annual exercise also held near Natuna in 2012.

Joint aerial surveillance over Natuna waters, after making Natuna a priority surveillance area in July 2013, is a new method (air surveillance cueing patrol vessels). The 2012 record shows only ship patrols and seizures (ev-d2d02adea6).

The first public statement by an Indonesian official that China's nine-dash line takes in Natuna waters, made while reviewing defences there, has nothing comparable in the 2013 record, which holds no declarative candidates; the 2012 passport rejection (ev-b21314c08f) did not name Natuna.

The Foreign Minister's restatement a week later that Indonesia rejects the nine-dash line belongs with ev-91faec81a8, the same 2014 public stand on the line. Its denial of any dispute over Natuna is conciliatory, which a coder may weigh against including it.

Moeldoko's WSJ op-ed expressing dismay that China's line takes in parts of Natuna is the same 2014 public naming of the overlap as ev-91faec81a8. Its announced reinforcement could instead go with the build-up group led by ev-2a1f165417.

The armed forces chief announcing added land, sea and air forces at Natuna and a main naval base, framed by South China Sea instability, is a new declared military build-up; nothing comparable appears in the 2013 record (only the exercise ev-90f5dfda84).
The plan to evaluate the West Kalimantan and Riau naval bases for main-base status is part of the same announced build-up as ev-2a1f165417 (same commander, same rationale).
Seizing five Vietnamese pair trawlers in the Natuna Sea continues the 2013 practice of ev-6f261ed319; 8 Vietnamese boats in Jan-Apr gives no step up. Provisional.

The November seizure of three Vietnamese boats off Tarempa is the same practice as 2013 (ev-6f261ed319). Their later destruction is a separate act, covered by the sinking move led by ev-499f08d5bc. Provisional.
Seizing a Malaysian-flagged boat in border waters off Tarempa continues the 2013 seizures of Malaysian boats (ev-6423cf1f68, itself undecided); provisional.
The President's order to sink rather than arrest foreign poaching boats launched the sinking policy, and is the same 2014 intensification as the first sinking, ev-499f08d5bc.

Blowing up seized Vietnamese boats off Anambas is a change of method from arrest and prosecution to destruction. The 2013 record shows seizures only (ev-6f261ed319, ev-b33eba6af8); the 2004 confiscation (ev-cdd40a3eca) was a lesser step.

Creating Bakamla to patrol Indonesian waters and jurisdiction zones is a new administrative arrangement, with nothing comparable in 2013. Low confidence: it is national, not specific to the South China Sea, and a coder may reject it under D(4).
Seizing four Vietnamese pair trawlers off Serasan continues the 2014 practice of ev-2558ab896f; provisional.

The President's statement that the nine-dash line has no basis in international law repeats the 2014 stand (ev-1b7562aeac, ev-91faec81a8) at a higher level of office but with the same method. A coder who counts the first presidential statement as novelty would make it a new move.

The sinking policy grew from one sinking of three boats in December 2014 (ev-499f08d5bc) to repeated mass sinkings in 2015 (6 boats off Pontianak here, then ev-169a8b7241, ev-acee3a30bb, ev-872229c888), including the first Chinese boat. A coder may instead read 2015 as the 2014 policy simply running for a full year.
Announcing a planned military base facing the South China Sea repeats the 2014 announced build-up (ev-2a1f165417, ev-4eff246f50); it is a statement of intent, not yet construction. Provisional.

Fourteen Vietnamese boats seized in a week around Natuna and Anambas is a concentrated burst of the 2014 practice (ev-2558ab896f). The Navy's national total (6 Vietnamese by August) shows no rise in frequency. Provisional.

Inaugurating Lantamal XII Pontianak with committed warships, aircraft and 1,300 personnel turns the 2014 announcements (ev-2a1f165417, ev-4eff246f50) into physical military development, a new demonstrative method against a declarative-only 2014.

The Independence Day mass sinking of 24 Navy-held and 15 KKP-held boats, largely Vietnamese, at Tarempa, Ranai, Pontianak and Lemukutan belongs to the 2015 escalation of sinkings led by ev-a4f944dc5e.
Seizures of two Vietnamese boats near Natuna in September continue the 2014 practice of ev-2558ab896f; provisional.
Stationing a drone and building barracks at the Pulau Sekatung border post is part of the same 2015 physical military build-up on the South China Sea front as ev-cbc293875b.
Parliament funding Rp450 billion of base facilities on Natuna, tied to South China Sea tension, is part of the same 2015 build-up as ev-cbc293875b.

Expelling an unidentified aircraft from airspace over the Natuna Islands is a new method, but the islands are not disputed and the intruder's nationality is unknown. Settled by whether the aircraft belonged to a rival claimant and was in airspace bearing on the South China Sea claim; otherwise likely reject.
The October sinkings of Vietnamese boats off Pontianak and Batam belong to the 2015 escalation of sinkings led by ev-a4f944dc5e.
Sinking six Vietnamese boats seized in the Anambas EEZ belongs to the 2015 escalation of sinkings led by ev-a4f944dc5e; the boats are those of the 1 August seizure in ev-e29ae434b2.

Warships already patrolled Natuna/Anambas waters in 2014 (ev-00d31aba18, Operation Rakata Jaya; ev-561125aa98), and the Navy calls the seven-ship deployment a routine anti-poaching patrol. A coder with 2014 ship numbers may instead see a frequency move.

A coordinating minister's threat to take China to an international court over its nine-dash line is a new method (threatened legal proceedings) beyond the 2014 statements of non-acceptance (ev-91faec81a8, ev-1b7562aeac).
The Foreign Ministry's statement that Indonesia does not recognise the nine-dash line and has asked China for clarification repeats the Foreign Minister's 2014 position (ev-1b7562aeac); provisional.
